title.text: Chapter 4: Poetry and Lyrics — Vocabulary and Terminology Quiz — answer key

segments.text: 1. His profound essay about the war impressed the whole class. What does “profound” mean here? (1 point)
2. They live a frugal life in a small house by the lake. What does “frugal” mean here? (1 point)
3. A peculiar noise woke her just after midnight. What does “peculiar” mean here? (1 point)
4. Everyone else changed their minds, but he stood his ground. What does “stood his ground” mean here? (1 point)

choices.text: crossed from one side to the other
refused to give up his position

key_evidence.text: Correct answer: D. refused to give up his position
key_evidence.value: refused to give up his position

segments.text: 5. “The kitchen smelled of cinnamon and warm bread.” Which term names the technique that appeals to the reader’s sense of smell? (1 point)
6. “Love is a locked room with no windows.” Which term names the direct equation of two unlike things without using like or as? (1 point)
7. In a poem, the person who talks is a tired nurse. The poet is a college student. Which term names the tired nurse? (1 point)

8. Read the stanza: We played all day in the sand (A) / You and I across the land (A) / The sea at night is wide and deep (B) / We hear it in our sleep (B). Which term names the arrangement of the same end sounds in the lines? (1 point)

key_evidence.text: Correct answer: F. attitude toward subject

key_evidence.text: Correct answer: C. beat of stressed syllables

segments.text: Select the meaning of “theme”.

key_evidence.text: Correct answer: D. central message of poem

segments.text: Select the meaning of “symbolism”.

key_evidence.text: Correct answer: G. use of symbols for ideas
